title: General error
fullDescription:
Frigidaire countertop and built-in ice makers display ER for unrecoverable controller faults. A power cycle clears most occurrences.

If ER persists, contact service.

title: Reservoir empty
fullDescription:
Add Water indicates the reservoir float is below the minimum threshold. Refill to the line and wait 30 seconds for sensor recovery.

A stuck float can cause false alerts.

fixSteps.title: Refill
fixSteps.instruction: Pour fresh water to max line.

title: Bin full sensor active
fullDescription:
Bin Full indicates the optical sensor sees ice piled to the lid. Production halts to avoid overflow.

Ice buildup against the sensor or condensation can cause false trips.

title: Evaporator sensor open
fullDescription:
E1 indicates the evaporator thermistor reading is out of range. The controller cannot regulate the harvest cycle without it.

Replace the sensor.

title: Compressor protection
shortDescription: Compressor failed to start or overloaded.
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the compressor protection circuit tripped. Causes include low voltage, failed start relay, or seized compressor.

Professional service typically required.

title: Pump fault
fullDescription:
E3 indicates the water circulation pump is not drawing the expected current. A blockage or failed pump is the cause.

Descale to clear mineral deposits.

faq.a: Acceptable for descaling on this model.

title: Fan fault
fullDescription:
E4 indicates the condenser fan is not spinning. Without it, heat cannot be rejected and ice production stops.

Clear obstructions and test motor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Pull rear panel, clear blade path.

faq.a: Some buzz expected; replace if grinding.

title: Clean reminder
fullDescription:
CL reminds users to run the descale/clean cycle. Production continues but performance may degrade.

Use approved cleaner.

faq.a: Up to a week, then performance drops.

title: Power failure
fullDescription:
PF indicates a brief power outage occurred. Press any key to acknowledge.

No action required beyond verifying settings.

title: High temperature warning
fullDescription:
HI indicates ambient or compartment temperature exceeded the safe range for production. Common during garage installs in summer.

Move unit or improve ventilation.
whenToCallPro: If condition worsens with cool ambient.

title: Long Freeze Cycle
fullDescription: Frigidaire ice maker E5 indicates the freeze cycle exceeded the allowed time without harvesting. Common with dirty condensers and undersized water flow.

fixSteps.title: Run diagnostics
fixSteps.instruction: Enter service mode per tech sheet to identify failed component.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM Frigidaire replacement and clear code.

whenToCallPro: Sealed-system work requires an EPA-certified technician.

faq.a: Many Frigidaire ice maker codes can be reset by power cycling, but recurring codes need diagnosis.
